tools.name: analyze_loudness
tools.description: Loudness and dynamics for a track: integrated LUFS (EBU R128 / BS.1770-4), true-peak (dBTP), loudness range (LRA), crest factor, stereo correlation, mono compatibility, and tonal balance. Audio source: a public https URL, or a local file path (`path`).

url.description: Public https URL to the audio file. Provide exactly one of url or path.

path.description: Path to a LOCAL audio file on this machine, analysed without hosting it publicly (files up to 4 MB are sent inline; larger ones up to 150 MB upload over a signed URL). Provide exactly one of url or path.

tools.name: check_target
tools.description: Verify whether audio hits a delivery target (Spotify -14 LUFS / EBU broadcast -23 / podcast -16 / etc.). Returns pass/fail with per-metric deltas and a concrete ffmpeg loudnorm command to fix if failing. Presets: spotify, apple-music, youtube, tidal, amazon-music, podcast, ebu-broadcast, atsc-broadcast; or target="custom" with lufs+tp. Audio source: a public https URL, or a local file path (`path`).

url.description: Public https URL to the audio file. Provide exactly one of url or path.

path.description: Path to a LOCAL audio file on this machine, analysed without hosting it publicly (files up to 4 MB are sent inline; larger ones up to 150 MB upload over a signed URL). Provide exactly one of url or path.

tools.name: analyze_timeseries
tools.description: Short-term LUFS samples over time (EBU R128, ~3s window) with their time-base, plus downsampled waveform peaks. Arrays suitable for loudness-over-time charts, level meters, and waveform UIs. Audio source: a public https URL, or a local file path (`path`).

url.description: Public https URL to the audio file. Provide exactly one of url or path.

path.description: Path to a LOCAL audio file on this machine, analysed without hosting it publicly (files up to 4 MB are sent inline; larger ones up to 150 MB upload over a signed URL). Provide exactly one of url or path.

There is no dominant-band field in the response. For spectrum-analyzer UIs and tonal-balance analysis. Audio source: a public https URL, or a local file path (`path`).

path.description: Path to a LOCAL audio file on this machine, analysed without hosting it publicly (files up to 4 MB are sent inline; larger ones up to 150 MB upload over a signed URL). Provide exactly one of url or path.

tools.name: analyze_profile
tools.description: Measure a file against a named working set of lenses and get back only what that question needs. Profiles: voice (is this take usable, and which phrase is the problem), master (will this translate to real platforms and speakers), provenance (what has been done to this file, and is it all one source), dataset (which of these files are good enough, and why not the rest), environment (what is in this space, and what kind of noise is it), broadcast (does this file meet the delivery spec), loop (is this loop clean, on the grid, and safe to drop in a DAW). basic is the free tier; the other seven need a paid plan. Results are keyed by stable lens id. Only the analysis passes the profile needs are run. Set series:true to also get the curves, the per-block lanes and the per-phrase values,a much larger payload, so leave it off unless you are going to read them. Audio source: a public https URL, or a local file path (`path`).

url.description: Public https URL to the audio file. Provide exactly one of url or path.

path.description: Path to a LOCAL audio file on this machine, analysed without hosting it publicly (files up to 4 MB are sent inline; larger ones up to 150 MB upload over a signed URL). Provide exactly one of url or path.

series.description: Include time series, per-block lanes and per-phrase arrays. Off by default.

tools.name: compare_loudness
tools.description: Run loudness analysis on TWO sources and return both results for an A/B comparison: master vs reference, before vs after a fix, two encoders, two cuts. Audio source: a public https URL, or a local file path (`path`).

urlA.description: First source URL (e.g. master). Provide urlA or pathA.

pathA.description: First source as a local file path.

urlB.description: Second source URL (e.g. reference). Provide urlB or pathB.

pathB.description: Second source as a local file path.

tools.name: analyze_batch
tools.description: Run one analysis route over up to 20 audio sources in a single call. Returns per-item ok/data/error; each item is metered as one call. Routes: mixlab/analyze (default), mixlab/check-target, mixlab/timeseries, mixlab/spectrum, voicelab/qa, voicelab/segments, signallab/index. Use for folder QA, library indexing, or checking a whole release against a loudness target. Sources: public https urls and/or local file paths.

urls.description: Public https URLs to audio files. Combined max 20 items with paths.

paths.description: LOCAL audio file paths; each uploads over a one-shot signed URL, is analysed, then deleted. Combined max 20 items with urls.

endpoint.description: Analysis route to run for every item (default mixlab/analyze).

target.description: For mixlab/check-target: preset id (spotify, ebu-broadcast, podcast, …) or "custom".
